title: 某团队在bioRxiv发表单管纳米孔测序方法RAMP-Seq
originalTitle: RAMP-Seq: a single-tube nanopore workflow for co-amplifying full-length 16S rRNA and antimicrobial resistance genes for integrated taxonomic and resistance profiling
summary: 某团队在bioRxiv发表单管纳米孔测序方法RAMP-Seq，该技术通过单一多联PCR扩增16S rRNA（约1500bp）和8种耐药基因（600-700bp），经纳米孔测序验证了双片段同步扩增的均一性（Pearson相关系数r=0.879）。

story.title: 某团队开发单管纳米孔测序方法RAMP-Seq用于16S rRNA及耐药基因分析

author: Pathak, D., Jagtap, S., Godbole, R., Patel, N., Mohammed, A., Jeevanandan, S. P., Sarkar, D., Roy, I., Shridhar, V., Natarajan, A., Srikantaiah, V., Roy, R.
